## Serial hold — queued BEHIND PR #17447. ⚠️ And the vocabulary this card says to reuse has been RETIRED

`domain:spec` execution seat, `session_01MkQhmuuJAVDjmeWNixwDDH`, 2026-09-10T15:01Z. ⛔ Not a claim — this card stays `pm:queue` and unassigned, ⛔ labels untouched. The ruling is not touched or reinterpreted; this is scheduling plus one measured premise.

### fold-or-serial, answered: **serial**

`GroupingFieldSchema` is declared at `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:853`, and its fixtures live in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.test.ts`. **PR #17447** (card #16577, opened 14:53Z) is open on **both of those exact files**. The folding gate fails at its first door — different defect shape (a padded-name accept vs an undocumented guard scope), different fix, different review requirement (this card is `Clause-②: yes` and needs an at-tier verdict; #17447 is a measured `no`). ⛔ Not folded, ⛔ not run in parallel.

⚠️ **Whoever picks this up: re-derive `:853` on the merged tree.** #17447 adds ~130 lines to `view.test.ts` and a docblock to `view.zod.ts`, so line numbers in that file will have moved. Anchor by content (`export const GroupingFieldSchema`), never by line.

### ⚠️ The premise worth knowing before you start — measured, not inherited

The ruling says:

> `GroupingFieldSchema.field` gets a **non-padded pattern** (the same shape the field-name vocabulary already uses elsewhere in `packages/spec` **if one exists — reuse it, do not invent a second**)

⭐ **Measured on `origin/main`: it does not exist any more.** `FieldNameSchema` was **retired under protocol 18** — there is a retired-def entry (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-defs/18.shared__FieldName.ts`) and a semantic entry (`18.branded-identifier-schemas-retired`) covering it, and the retired-def's own text records why:

> No schema in either repo ever composed `FieldNameSchema`…

⇒ The card's conditional resolves to its **second** branch, and the dev will have to define the pattern rather than reuse one. ⚠️ ⛔ That is **not** licence to invent a general field-name vocabulary as a rider — the ruling asks for a non-padded pattern on **one key**, and reviving a retired branded-identifier family would be re-opening a protocol-18 retirement. ⭐ Whoever takes this should state, in the PR, which of those two things they did and why. If the honest answer turns out to be "this needs the retired vocabulary back", that is a **回翻** — stop and return the card, ⛔ do not decide it in the round.

### Potholes recorded at the moment of deferral, per the serial discipline

- **`Clause-②: yes` is fixed by the ruling**, not by the diff's measurement — the card cites the objectui#8285 precedent that a spec narrowing declares `yes`. ⇒ `needs:contract-review` on **both carriers**, an at-tier verdict on the head that lands, `minor` + a `**BREAKING**` note, and an ADR-0087 disposition. ⛔ Do not re-declare `no` on the ground that the diff looks small.
- ⚠️ **The ADR-0087 disposition means a migration entry**, which means `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` — a **hot file with two open writers today** (#17439, queued; #17334, in flight). Expect merge-queue arbitration; ⛔ never hand-edit between the `os-generated` markers, and ⛔ never reorder the queue manually.
- **The fixture enumeration is an acceptance criterion, not a formality.** The card says: a narrowing that reddens an in-tree grouping fixture is a **finding to report**, ⛔ not a reason to widen the pattern to fit. Enumerate them with a lit control (a fixture known to carry `grouping.fields[]`) and a dark control.
- ⛔ **Not `.trim()`** — the ruling is explicit that a trimming schema makes `'  a  '` and `'a'` silently equivalent, which is the consumer-tolerance direction AGENTS.md #0.1 refuses. The objectui-side trim stays as defence-in-depth; nothing is removed there.
- The changeset must name **objectui#7347** as unblocking on the **installable release**, ⛔ not on merge.
- ⚠️ The sibling `groupByField` axis (kanban / gantt / timeline) is symmetric and is explicitly ⛔ **not** this card. Do not widen into it.

Refs: PR #17447 (the holder) · card #16577 · objectui#7347 (blocked on this) · decision batch #110 item 5 · `18.branded-identifier-schemas-retired`

The target key, read at that anchor:

```ts
field: z.string().describe('Field name to group by — one `groupBy` column of the group header query; …'),
```

`field` is a bare `z.string()`, so `'  business_unit  '` is valid authored metadata. objectui measured (M1–M11 with live controls) that the projection harvester **trims** the name for `$select` while **three** renderers bucket rows by the **raw** name — `plugin-grid` `usableGroupingFields`, `plugin-list` `ObjectGallery.groupedItems`, `plugin-kanban` `effectiveSwimlaneField`. The server answers under `business_unit`, the readers look up the padded spelling, every row reads `undefined`, and the view shows one `(empty)` group or one `Uncategorized` lane holding every record — ⭐ a silent wrong answer that reads as a true statement about the data.

**Acceptance, from the card:**
- a refusal pin: a padded name is refused **by name** at `grouping.fields[N].field`;
- **control**: the clean name still parses;
- ⭐ **and every existing grouping fixture in the repo still parses — enumerate them.** A narrowing that reddens an in-tree fixture is a **finding to report**, ⛔ **not** a reason to widen the pattern to fit. - the changeset names **objectui#7347** as unblocking on the **installable release**, ⛔ not on merge.
